title: TutorialBook
description: In-game handbook for rules, guides, and tutorials—reduce support spam and onboard players fast.
body:
# TutorialBook 

Every server needs documentation—but players won’t read Discord walls. TutorialBook puts your guides directly in-game: rules, systems, classes, economy, “how to start”, and more. Players learn faster, ask less, and your server feels instantly more polished.

# Highlights:

Central in-game guide/book system

Great for onboarding, FAQs, rules, progression explanations

Reduces repetitive questions and support workload

Perfect for: RPG servers, public servers, complex systems.

# Why you’ll love it

Players learn in-game instead of asking staff

Makes complex servers feel easy to start

Central place for guides, rules, and systems

# Features

Central in-game book/handbook content

Ideal for onboarding, FAQs, progression explanations

Easily updateable content workflow

# Setup

Install the plugin

Add your guide content/providers

Give players access (join, command, NPC reward, etc.)

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Resource pack: optional (only if you use custom models)
